title: My First Bug Bounty: CORS Misconfiguration
summary_en: I think CORS misconfiguration vulnerability is not hard to find. But, if this vulnerability occurs on a particular endpoint that includes users’ personal data, external attacker can access to the victim’s data and the data can be leaked.
